(b) The mode-weight definition in q42_post.py (KDE bw 0.25 in log T, 10% prominence, valley<0.5 peak) is ad hoc and has no validation on a known bimodal test. (c) Convergence is not demonstrated by any between-seed logZ or mode-weight agreement.
